family_title_en: Complete the word with a three-letter consonant blend

stages.ix_title: Complete the word with a three-letter consonant blend

prompt.en: Which three letters start the word?
prompt.ko: 그 단어는 어떤 세 글자로 시작하나요?

what_to_do.en: Find the word that starts with three consonants and tap them.
what_to_do.ko: 자음 세 개로 시작하는 단어를 찾아 그 글자를 누르세요.

stages.choice_rule: Build four lowercase three-letter blends from str, spr, spl, scr, squ, shr, and thr. Exactly one choice is the first three letters of the single blend word in the stem. Tier 1 distractors look unlike the answer. Tier 2 distractors share letters with it. Tier 3 adds the nearest one-letter miss. Do not offer two-letter blends as choices.

gold_items.stem: We splash in the little pool.
The spring days are very sunny.
<NAME> saw a strong horse by the tree.
Please spray water on the green grass.

roots: Use whole words only. The stem has exactly one word that starts with a three-letter consonant blend.
Other words may start with one consonant, with th, sh, or ch, or with a two-letter blend such as tr, gr, or pl.
Never put two three-letter blend words in the same stem.
Offer four lowercase choices from str, spr, spl, scr, squ, shr, and thr, and make exactly one correct.
Tier 1 distractors must not share the first two letters with the answer.
Tier 2 distractors stay close in spelling but are still the wrong first three letters.
Tier 3 stems are longer and include a two-letter blend decoy plus a one-letter-miss choice.
Vary which choice index is correct so the answer is not always first.
Keep sentences in a kid world of home, school, food, pets, play, family, or weather, with no brands.
Do not use real names. If a person is needed, write <NAME> and set swap_slots.NAME to names.txt.
Add one media lemma, the blend word itself. Do not describe a picture in the stem.
No IPA, no slashes, and no held clips. Choices are the blend's letters.
Off-list blend words must come from allowed_extra_words. Do not invent word fragments.

tier_rules.1: Four or five words with one common blend word such as three, stripe, or squeeze. Distractors do not share the answer's first two letters.
tier_rules.2: Five to seven grade-level words. Distractors are close spellings, such as str beside spr or spl beside spr.
tier_rules.3: Seven to ten words with a two-letter blend decoy in the sentence and one distractor that misses the answer by a single letter.
